mapper.select: select distinct category_title from watcha_rank where save_date = (select MAX(save_date) from watcha_rank)

select m.period, m.country, w.*, r.media_rank from media m, watcha w, watcha_rank r where r.category_title = #{categoryTitle} and m.media_div = '2' /* tv프로그램만 조회 */ and r.media_id = w.media_id and m.media_id = w.media_id and r.save_date = (select MAX(save_date) from watcha_rank) order by r.media_rank

select m.media_id , m.media_name , m.media_div , m.director , m.actor , m.producer , m.distributor , m.author , m.channel , m.open_date , m.period , m.country , m.running_time , m.rating_grade , m.genre , m.media_code , m.watchable , w.img_src from media m left join watcha w on m.media_id = w.media_id where ( m.media_name like concat('%', #{searchInput}, '%') or m.director like concat('%', #{searchInput}, '%') or m.actor like concat('%', #{searchInput}, '%') or m.genre like concat('%', #{searchInput}, '%') ) order by m.rank asc, m.update_date desc

select m.*, w.img_src from media m left join watcha w on m.media_id = w.media_id where m.media_div = '1' /* 영화만 조회 */ order by m.update_date desc, m.save_date desc, m.rank, m.open_date desc limit 0, 10

select comm_id, comm_div, writer, title, content, like_cnt, dislike_cnt, ( case comm_div when '1' then ( select case count(*) when 0 then 'false' else 'true' end from vote v, vote_user u where v.comm_id = c.comm_id and v.vote_id = u.vote_id and u.email_id = #{loginEmailId} ) when '2' then 'false' end ) as user_selected, ( select case count(*) when 0 then 'false' else 'true' end from community_like_user b where b.comm_id = c.comm_id and b.email_id = #{loginEmailId} and b.like_type = 'like' ) as user_liked, ( select case count(*) when 0 then 'false' else 'true' end from community_like_user b where b.comm_id = c.comm_id and b.email_id = #{loginEmailId} and b.like_type = 'dislike' ) as user_disliked, ( select count(*) from comment a where a.comm_id = c.comm_id ) as comment_cnt from community c where (title != null or title != '') and dislike_cnt <= 20 order by like_cnt desc limit 4
